name: claude-trades
description: Dev tools only (lint, types). The site has no build step; Pages serves site/ as-is.

scripts.types: python tools/check_baseline.py tsc -- npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.types:update: python tools/check_baseline.py tsc --update -- npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.py: python tools/check_baseline.py ruff -- python -m ruff check --output-format json . && python tools/check_baseline.py mypy -- python -m mypy scripts tools
scripts.py:update: python tools/check_baseline.py ruff --update -- python -m ruff check --output-format json . && python tools/check_baseline.py mypy --update -- python -m mypy scripts tools
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run types && npm run py && npm run claims
